description: Shared Renovate preset for every repo in the tektonic-ci org: core extends it as local>tektonic-ci/core//renovate/tektonic-ci, and so do the provider repos. It lives here rather than in tektonic-ci/.github because agent sessions cannot attach that repo.
Goal: in-range updates batch weekly and merge themselves on green CI; majors, the peer range and security fixes are the only PRs that need a human.

Automerge leans on GitHub's native auto-merge (platformAutomerge), which waits only on the checks branch protection marks required. The PR pipeline's checks must be required on main and test-core-next must not be — it is advisory, and Renovate's own fallback merge would treat its red status as a failure. Without branch protection, GitHub has nothing to wait for and Renovate falls back to requiring every status green.
PR automerge rather than branch automerge: the push pipeline does run on renovate/* branches, but it skips build-npm.

The schedule is in America/Los_Angeles, the timezone of the self-hosted Renovate CronJob (0 2-23/4 * * *), so the window holds the same runs year-round; in UTC it would drift against the cron at each DST change. Monday 00:00-11:59 catches the 02:00, 06:00 and 10:00 runs: the first opens the weekly PRs, the others are backups if one is missed. Existing branches are still rebased outside the window (updateNotScheduled), so a PR left conflicted by another merge is fixed at the next 4-hourly run.

npm 12 defaults allow-remote=none, and its --package-lock-only path rejects registry tarballs that declare bundleDependencies (cdk8s does) with EALLOWREMOTE, so every lockfile artifact update failed (npm/cli#9800, unfixed as of 12.0.2). Pinned to 11.19+, the line CLAUDE.md requires for npm stage; drop the pin once a fixed npm 12 ships.

.tekton/ is synthesized from TypeScript (image pins, and the @tektonic-ci/core that runs synth), so a bump can change it; without this the manifests are left behind and check-manifests fails the PR, correctly. This runs the generator on the branch after the bump, so the PR carries both sides.
Runs on every branch: fileFilters means a branch whose synthesis is byte-identical commits nothing, and a dependency that does move the output is caught rather than assumed not to exist.
executionMode 'branch' runs the generator once over the final set of pins, not once per upgrade in a group.
Needs the self-hosted Renovate's global allowedCommands to admit '^npm ci' and '^npm run synth', or the tasks are skipped silently. check-manifests in self-CI stays the backstop.

packageRules.description: Generated manifests are output, not source: the built-in ansible manager matches any tasks/*.yaml, so it would propose editing .tekton/tasks/*.k8s.yaml while the TypeScript pins stayed behind (and the next synth reverted it). A packageRule rather than ignorePaths, so postUpgradeTasks.fileFilters can keep matching .tekton/**.
The peer range on core is a compatibility promise, widened deliberately in a release of its own (ADR 0002), not bumped by a bot.
Every in-range npm update in one weekly PR, merged on green CI. Almost all of these are lockfile-only (the range already admits them), and npm test typechecks and runs the suite against the result.
The org's own packages skip the release-age wait and the schedule, so a release in one repo lands in the others the same day instead of the next Monday.
vite and vitest majors move together; non-major updates are already in the npm non-major group.

description: One PR for every CI image pin (the custom regex managers in each repo), not one per image. A re-synth rewrites whichever task manifests use the image, so separate image PRs conflict with each other the moment one merges. Grouped, the generator runs once over the final set of pins.

separateMajorMinor is off for the same reason: the images all come from the same apko-cicd repo, and a split major PR would be a second branch racing the minor one over the same generated files. So a group that holds a major is not automerged (next rule).

packageRules.description: Non-major image bumps merge on green CI: the full PR pipeline runs on the new images, and check-manifests catches a synth that did not follow.
